references.text: The same ritual with blood from the guilt offering on the right earlobe, right thumb, and right big toe, which here is replaced by oil in the same places.
Parallel text describing the same action with oil on the three places, but in the ordinary cleansing ritual for lepers.
At the consecration of Aaron and his sons, blood was applied to the same three places: the right earlobe, the right thumb, and the right big toe.
Instructions for priestly consecration with blood on the right earlobe, the right thumb, and the right big toe.
The blood of the guilt offering mentioned here ('דַּם הָאָשָׁם') was applied to the same three places earlier in the ritual.
